name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
mechanism: Humanised anti-HER2 IgG1 linked via a cleavable tetrapeptide linker to a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload (deruxtecan, an exatecan derivative) at a high drug-to-antibody ratio. The membrane-permeable payload produces a bystander effect on neighbouring cells, enabling activity in HER2-positive, HER2-low and HER2-ultralow breast cancer and in HER2-mutant or HER2-overexpressing NSCLC.
monitoring: Clinical surveillance for respiratory symptoms and consideration of periodic chest imaging; interrupt and treat suspected ILD promptly
resistance: Reduced HER2 expression, impaired internalisation/trafficking, and payload resistance (topoisomerase I alterations, efflux). Cross-resistance between topoisomerase I payload ADCs is under study.
